$comment: Generated by scripts/generate_plural_corpus.py from the Python plural runtime, and verified against Intl.PluralRules in Node: `indexes[k - 1]` is the index of the form a message with k forms must use for count `n` in `locale`. `n` is a decimal string, and only values that survive a JavaScript String(Number(x)) round trip appear, so a Node cross-check sees the same visible fraction digits; every count is below 2**53, above which a JavaScript number is no longer the integer it was written as. `category` is the plain CLDR category, before the arity ladder and before the explicit `zero` rule.
